errors.text_span: Червеният и лилавият сектор са с еднакъв размер, всеки заемащ 23%
errors.evidence: The description states that the red and purple sectors each occupy 23%, but they are misidentified; the actual distribution is different.
The description does not mention that the sectors do not have a clear legend in the figure, only sector labels are provided.
The description does not mention the absence of a y-axis or the percentage display as part of the visual features.
